source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB restart-cause query; no stimulus/reset is part of this read case.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x00/0x07; decode restart cause and channel; clear logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; chassis restart-cause; password in argv; user judges.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correct query direction but unsafe credentials and no deterministic decoding.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE read-only query with reserved-value handling and preserved timeline.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Historical cause does not prove a stimulus unless the Project provides a correlated timeline.

original_test_intent: Read and decode the BMC-recorded system restart cause and reporting channel for the verified SUT.
original_method: Send raw Chassis 0x00/0x07 and interpret the returned cause and channel bytes.
manual_activity: Owner supplies target-specific expected cause/channel mapping and any stimulus timeline once.
required_inputs: Expected cause or preserved event timeline
agent_execution_scope: Correlate with approved timeline if supplied

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: High-level restart-cause is a useful cross-check but argv credentials and unparsed user judgment are insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected raw 0x00/0x07, decode both fields and compare to preserved reset/boot evidence without causing a restart.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Raw command, response fields, Script and timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform one secret-safe read, retain raw bytes, decode cause/channel and correlate with an authoritative timeline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic parsing and evidence preservation while removing log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A decoded historical value alone does not prove any newly executed reset mechanism.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Stale or vendor-specific cause values can be misattributed without a timeline.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor property is equivalent only if it returns the same cause/channel semantics and freshness; no reset may be added as an implicit prerequisite.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, raw command and response fields align; Criteria is incomplete but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read semantics are explicit; expected historical cause and mapping are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Replaces unparsed command success with cause/channel validation and preserves the evidence needed for causal interpretation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Restart cause is retained historical state, not an active test stimulus. The channel byte and cause code must be decoded independently and timestamp-correlated; if no authoritative event timeline exists, the automation can report the value but cannot claim that a particular restart path passed.
